findings.title: Bind claimed complete review counts to pinned inputs
findings.evidence: A fresh public toy has96required facts. Changing pinned metadata coverage.required_facts to1 while all_required_facts_reviewed remains true produces independent_review_metadata_validated with required_facts_reviewed=1. The guard accepts any positive fact count rather than comparing with the pinned gold.
findings.impact: An internally inconsistent completeness attestation passes the mechanical pre-dispatch gate. This does not prove semantic review absent, but the claimed mechanical count is not enforced.
findings.fix: Before a success receipt or phase dispatch, derive question and required-fact counts from exact pinned fixture/gold bytes and reject count mismatches. Keep detailed findings opaque. Test undercount and overcount as well as matching counts.

other_assessment: Generic future author guidance preserves fixed thresholds, difficult cases, deletion negatives and role/time/scope qualifications. It does not modify historical gold.
Separate reviewer allowlist and sealed detailed findings prevent deliberate product/answer exposure; metadata acceptance remains an attestation, not proof.
Optional author_fact_rationale_sha256 is already supported by the full findings schema; no finding on appendix binding.
Source hash, acceptance, unresolved finding, boolean completeness and input binding rejection otherwise precede phase dispatch; R17 protocol must declare the optional guard.

clearance.condition: Resolve count consistency before final pack approval; preserve reviewed version and public red reproduction.

limits: No product-worker files, R16 fixture/gold, private author content or grades read.
No model calls or reviewed source changes.
Only the new review artifact was written.
